anchor.text:
# The payment provider, as the shop talks to it. Charges are created by the worker (payments/charge.go);
# the provider then sends the customer to their bank for 3-D Secure and calls the webhook below when it knows.
provider:
  name: examplepay
  apiBase: https://api.examplepay.test/v1
  # auto: 3-D Secure only when the bank asks for it; always: every charge.
  threeDSecure: auto
  webhook:
    path: /api/payments/webhook
    events: [charge.succeeded, charge.failed, charge.expired]
  # A charge the bank has not answered in this time expires on the provider's side.
  chargeTimeout: 15m
  retries: 3

messages.author: Claude
messages.body:
**8. Asynchronous hop 2: the provider asks the bank (not our code)**

No code in this repo talks to the bank. The provider sends the customer to their bank's 3-D Secure page and calls the shop's webhook when it knows the answer. How often that happens is set here: `threeDSecure: auto` (line 7: only when the bank asks for it). Note the charge expires on the provider's side after 15 minutes (line 12). I did not read the provider's code; the events are what `ChargeIssues` expects (payments/status.go:43).
